ground_coverage.name: Ground Coverage Percentage
ground_coverage.suggestion: Reduce building footprint area relative to plot area.

fsi.name: Floor Space Index (FSI)
fsi.suggestion: Reduce total built-up area across floors.

building_height.name: Maximum Building Height
building_height.suggestion: Reduce number of floors or floor-to-floor height.

front_setback.name: Front Setback Distance
front_setback.suggestion: Increase clearance between building front and plot boundary.

rear_setback.name: Rear Setback Distance
rear_setback.suggestion: Increase clearance at rear of plot.

side_setback.name: Side Setback Distance
side_setback.suggestion: Increase side clearance to plot boundary.

rain_water_harvesting.name: Rain Water Harvesting Pit
rain_water_harvesting.suggestion: Provide at least one Rain Water Harvesting pit on site.

solar_panels.name: Rooftop Solar PV Installation
solar_panels.suggestion: Install rooftop solar panels covering minimum required area.
